acquisitionMethod: DuckDB remote Parquet projection; no dataset row endpoint and no phishing URL fetch
selectionRule: Within test shard 0, filter each source label, order by sha256 ascending, normalize URL, deduplicate by normalized URL, and take the first 20 valid records per label before evaluation.
featureScope: URL-only metadata; title, visible text, inputs, forms, links, HTTP status, redirects, network behavior, and screenshots are unavailable.
